en.content:
Which of the following compounds will form significant amount of meta product during mono-nitration
reaction?
en.explanation:
Nitration takes place in presence of concentrated HNO3 + concentrated H2SO4.

In strongly acidic nitration medium, the amine is converted into anilinium ion (– NH3+ ); substitution is thus controlled not by – NH2 group but by – NH3+ group which, because of its positive charge, directs the entering group to the meta-position instead of ortho and para.

en.content:
In the following reactions, ZnO is respectively acting as a/an :

(a) ZnO + Na2O Na2ZnO2

(b) ZnO + CO2 ZnCO3

options.content: base and base
acid and acid
acid and base
base and acid

en.explanation:
Zinc oxide (ZnO) when react with Na2O it act as acid while with CO2 it act as base. Therefore, it is an amphoteric oxide.

(a) ZnO + Na2O Na2ZnO2
     Acid      Base          Salt

(b) ZnO + CO2 ZnCO3
     Base      Acid       Salt
